bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Warp Touched
bonuses.text: Whenever a Mindwitch rolls a Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test, they gain bonus Wrath dice equal to the Tier of the game.

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Mindwitch attempts to activate Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power (W&G p.280).

abilities.name: Psychic Storm
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Mindwitch attempts to activate a psychic power or Deny the Witch (W&G p.267).
